violations.affected_code: Semantics(hint: 'Add to cart', child: MouseRegion(cursor: SystemMouseCursors.click, child: GestureDetector(onTap: onAddToCart, ...)))
violations.explanation: The tappable card is built from GestureDetector wrapped in Semantics without button: true. Screen readers will not announce it as a button or actionable control. The hint alone does not convey the button role.

violations.affected_code: Semantics(hint: 'Add to cart', child: ... Text(name) ... Text('\$$price') ...)
violations.explanation: The Semantics wrapper lacks container: true or MergeSemantics. The name and price texts may be exposed as separate nodes, and the hint may not be associated with a single actionable element. The tap action can end up detached from the product label.
The add-to-cart Icon has no semanticLabel. Its purpose as the action indicator is conveyed only visually.

violations.type: Missing keyboard/focus accessibility for custom control
violations.explanation: GestureDetector is not focusable and has no keyboard activation. On a desktop card, keyboard users cannot reach or activate add-to-cart. Use InkWell, a button, or FocusableActionDetector instead.
